your_book:
Jaleel's book slipped slightly today (Wednesday, Oct 21). On the weights given, the net move was roughly -0.2%, and unrealized performance stands at -1.41%. The damage came from the defensive and quality names. BSX fell 2.35% at a 9.2% weight, ABT fell 1.89% at 10.4%, ONON fell 3.39% and LULU fell 3.41%. NVDA (+2.54%) and a 5.44% bounce in RKLB offset most of it. The ABT headline describes an AI-led Nasdaq rally, which fits money leaving defensives for growth.

The drift is in three places. RKLB is an AVOID (QARP 42.4) and is still down 31.5%. Today's only headline is generic options-flow chatter, so treat the bounce as noise, not a thesis change. BSX is rated STRONG BUY (QARP 79.9) and is down 9.2%, yet management cut FY26 growth guidance to 7-8.5% and guides flat through Q3. The score and the guidance disagree. LULU, an AVOID, is down 24.5% after a guidance cut. Also, the NVDA and AVGO headlines describe semis falling on rate-hike fears, while both stocks rose. That mismatch means the narrative is unreliable today.

Watch ABT's results, which are due today, then BSX on Oct 28 and NVDA on Nov 17.
